description: The predicted next funding rate of each coin on Hyperliquid and the exchanges the data licence allows (annualised, as fractions), with each venue’s funding interval and next funding time. Use it for "what will BTC funding be at the next settlement?". For its history use get_predicted_funding_history.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Number of coins, by Hyperliquid open interest (default 10, at most 50).

name: get_predicted_funding

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

predicted.description: Rows of GET /funding/predicted: coin, byVenue (fundingHourly, fundingApr, intervalHours, nextFundingTime), updatedAt.

title: Predicted next funding
